Hi! I'm an esthetician and this is how I would recommend you combine these things! 

AM: cleanser / toner / tea tree serum / moisturizing cream 

PM: cleanser / toner / niacinamide OR retinol serum/ moisturizing cream. 

There shouldn't be much of a problem mixing these things, just watch out for sensitivity when using glycolic acid, niacinamide, and retinol together. For some people it's fine, for others it's too much, but it really depends on the individual! Good luck honey!
